name: spot-return-unreachable
description: The other half of spot-return (2026-11-09): the remembered spot is inside a closed ring of player-built walls the troll must not break. After unloading it walks there, fails two recovery cycles and gives the place up (D-187 best effort), then farms from where it stands. It must NOT reach the spot and must NOT hit a wall. Ring radius 14 m: the troll counts as arrived within 12 m of the spot, so a smaller ring (first try 6 m, 00:58) is "reached" from outside the wall.

steps.name: stt.walledTree
steps.label: a Beech inside a closed ring of stone walls (two high, radius 14 m = bigger than the troll's 12 m arrival distance, so standing at the wall is NOT arriving) 60 m east - the spot will be this place
the whole ring stands (28 walls per layer, two high)

the place is injected as the remembered spot AND the pack is filled in ONE call, at a moment when the troll works on a source it already remembered (polled until then: a swing at a NEW source would replace the spot)

steps.name: stt.followedSpotDrift
steps.label: the remembered spot is exactly the injected one

steps.name: stt.followedStatus
steps.label: precondition: the followed troll is loaded, owned here and remembers exactly the injected spot (any other answer NAMES the reason: NOT_LOADED / NO_FARMER / NO_REMEMBERED_SPOT / NOT_OWNER / SPOT_MISMATCH)

steps.name: stt.stepAside
steps.label: the player steps 25 m south, off the troll's way to the spot (a troll that walks past a player who looks at it is frozen by TrollHold - run agent24-s1)
the troll unloaded (an EVENT in the trip journal, not a state that has to be caught between two polls)

steps.name: stt.followedSpotDecision
steps.label: the troll decided to walk back to the spot (any skip names its reason: NoSpot / TooClose / OutsideLeash)

steps.name: stt.followedSpotDrift
steps.label: still exactly the injected spot after the unload
the walk back ended by the troll GIVING THE PLACE UP (two failed recovery cycles) - it did not reach it and was not cancelled

steps.name: stt.wallsHitByTroll
steps.label: no hit of a tamed troll reached a player-built wall (PlayerPieceGuard)

steps.name: stt.followedFarming
steps.label: it farms again from where it stands

asserts.name: stt.followedUnloadedAll
asserts.label: every stack filled was delivered (unload ledger)

asserts.name: stt.followedSpotDecision
asserts.label: the decision after the unload was to walk back

asserts.name: stt.followedJournalValid
asserts.label: the trip events came in a legal order
